title: lint: warn when a permission set's View All / Modify All re-opens a field another set hides, and steer high-sensitivity fields to `requiredPermissions` (step 2 of #34365)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzFAE8YRsK8YCDAeLL

Filing gate: ④ sub-card of the ruled decision #34365 (ruling 6912661484, verbatim 「同意，立决策卡」; implementation cards are cut after PR #34082, merged 2026-11-16T21:40Z) · Source: topic #34365

Parent: #34365 (step 2)
Blocked-by: #36050
Grade: left to triage. Suggested **p2** (a step of the p2 security card #34365). Area: data. Type suggestion: Feature.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue viewAllFields` → 3 hits: #34365 (the parent), #33828 (closed), #6015 (triage seat post). No card covers this step.

## Business reason

The hotcrm#2481 case: an author hides a field from consultants with a `readable: false` row, and a holder who also has another set with View All on the object reads it anyway. Nothing tells the author. The ruled path (#34365 step 2) adds a lint warning for exactly this, so authors fix it now, and so the v19 switch (View All / Modify All stop voting on fields) changes nothing they did not already see.

## What to build

- A warning in `packages/lint` (beside `validate-security-posture.ts`, same reading of sets and field rows): for a field `obj.f` that some set hides (`readable: false`, or an edit lock), and another set grants View All (read) or Modify All (read + edit) on `obj` (or on `'*'`), name both sets and the field, and say what to do: drop the bit, add `viewAllFields` if the second set really should read every field, or — for a field that must stay hidden from everyone without a capability (salary, ID numbers) — gate it on the field with `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D3), plus `maskingRule` where a partial value is needed. That last sentence is the ruled steering for high-sensitivity fields (#34365 decision point 2).
- Rule text in `rule-explanations.ts` and the user-text table, as the lint package requires for a new rule id.

## Constraints

- Warning, not error, at this step: no app that builds today stops building.
- No field-name heuristics (no guessing "salary" from a name): the rule fires only on the declared two-set shape above.
- Check the relation to `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` (same-set case): the new rule is the cross-set case; the PR says why they do not double-report.

## Declarations the PR owes

`Clause-②: no` (a warning; nothing an author writes is refused). `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Acceptance

- Fixture tests: two-set hide + View All fires; + Modify All fires; + `viewAllFields` on the second set fires; one set alone does not; a field gated by `requiredPermissions` does not.
- Gates green; L1 PASS on the final head.
